lines.en: Another[school] day comes to a close as I sit in my office and try to figure out why this part of the job even exists.
If the[school] is able to hire new janitors every time Ayane destroys one, how come they can’t hire a normal guidance counselor?
I’m entirely unqualified for this.
In fact, I’m entirely unqualified for virtually everything I do.
Has no one in the staff really figured that out by now?
: Senseiiiiii~ Can I come in?
Ami knocks on the door, probably to see if I can...love her or something. I don't know.
It’s not often that she actually comes in here for counseling.
In fact, she’s never come in here for counseling, so I don’t really know what else it would be.
: Yeah, you can. Door’s open.
Ami enters the room and stops directly in front of my desk with a smirk on her face that says she's here for a little more than just love.
: You want something, don’t you?
: Me? What gave you that idea?
: Your face. You don’t smile like that unless you want something from me.
: That’s not true. I don’t want anything other than some quality time with my [uncle].
: Are you coming on to me right now?
: If I say yes, can we do it on your desk?
: Sure.
: Wait, really?
: I know you're not a great teacher, but I didn’t think you’d agree to something like that so easily.
: That seems like a pretty horrible idea, Sensei.
: It would be bad enough for you to get caught doing something like that in general...but I think it takes on a new level of ‘bad’ if it’s your [niece] that you’re, you know, doing stuff with.
: Sometimes, life is about taking risks, Ami. This is something you’ll come to learn with age.
: I’m sure I will. But that’s really not why I’m here today.
: Then why are you here today?
: Whaaaat? Me coming on to my [uncle]? As if something like that would ever happen.
: Hahahahah...
: Hahaha...
: Hah...
Well, it’s nice to see that Ami is just as bad at hiding things as ever.
: If you’re not coming on to me...what is it then?
: You normally just walk in and ask for whatever it is you want, so it seems a little weird that you’re not doing that today.
: Well, Sensei...I, Ami Arakawa, have come to your office on this fine day to inform you that I have heard a rumor circulating that may or may not involve you and our class.
: I...do not like the sound of that.
: Why? Have you been doing anything naughty with any of them?
: Wait, why are you staying quiet?! That was a joke!
: You’re supposed to be like “Of course not! I would never do something like that with anyone but you, Ami!”
: You’re supposed to be like “Of course not! I would never do something like that with a student!”
: Of course I wouldn’t do anything like that.
...and admit to it.
: I don’t like the tone of your voice, Sensei...But I’m going to ignore it because I’m such a great [niece] and want to tell you about the thing I heard.
Well...at least it seems like whatever this rumor is doesn’t involve anything that could get me fired- which is great news.
It would be one thing to lose my job over something like that, but I’m actually a little more terrified of what Ami would do to me if she ever found out.
: Okay, Ami...What is it you heard?
: Oh, right.
: I have heard that-
: Sensei? Are you in there right now?
: Good. I’m coming in. Pardon the intrusion.
: Oh, hello Ami. I didn’t realize you were in here as well.
: I just wanted to stop by to discuss the details of the upcoming transfer students.
: AAAAAAAH!!! THAT’S WHAT I WAS HERE TO TALK ABOUT!! YOU STOLE MY BIG REVEAL!
: I’m sorry...what transfer students?
: Why would you come here to discuss that? Official classroom business is my territory. I don’t understand how you’d be involved.
: I’m involved because Sensei is my [uncle] and I love him!
: That doesn’t have anything to do with[school] whatsoever.
: Sure it does! I go to[school] and so does Sensei!
: Is anyone going to tell me what’s going on here or do I just need to figure it out on my own?
: New girls! Class! Soon!
: Makoto. Please translate.
: It’s more or less as Ami said.
: It seems that the principal caught on to the fact that our class has significantly less students than most of the others, and so two girls will soon be transferring in.
: Oh. So they’re not like, technically transfer students. They’re just switching classes.
: Sure. If that makes it easier for you to understand.
Lame.
: Do you have any questions regarding the process?
: Yes.
: Are they cute?
: Aww. You two look like twins now.
I can’t help but feel like I asked the wrong question.
But in all fairness, what else was I supposed to ask there?
I just got straight to the point and I should be respected as a man for that. I don’t need to beat around the bush.
: Is that...really the only question you have?
: Yes, Sensei. Is that really the only question you have? Especially with an adorable girl already standing right in front of you?
: Thank you, Ami. I didn’t realize you looked at me that way.
: I don’t. I think you’re ugly and stupid. I was talking about me.
: Oh, I see. You’re trying to get your [uncle] to notice how attractive you think you are. That is not at all abnormal.
: It would make much more sense for Sensei to be attracted to someone he isn’t related to. And since I am the only other girl in this room, that would have to be me.
: Oh, please. The only person who would ever be attracted to you is like...a...weird person...or something.
: Is that really all you can come up with?
: Shut up. I’m cute and you’re gross.
: If you two wouldn’t mind, I’d really like to hear more about this transfer situation now.
: I can’t help but feel like it’s something I should be at least slightly prepared for.
: Right. Apologies, Sensei. Let me get back to the matter at hand.
: My name’s Makoto. I’m a grown woman trapped in a [teenage]girl’s body. My eyesight is bad. Blah blah blah.
: Ami. Stop.
: Hmph...
: I wish I had more details to share with you, but all I really know right now is that two girls are going to be transferring over from Ms. Watabe’s class in the near future.
: Ms. Watabe is a bit...closed-off. So she was only willing to discuss some of the situation with me.
: Regardless, I think we can expect at least one of them in the next few days. I just haven't been notified of which one yet.
: Wait, is it really Ms. Watabe’s class that the girls are transferring from? I heard it was a different teacher.
: I’m not quite sure where you would have heard anything. My information came directly from the principal.
: Oh, sorry. I forgot you spend too much time studying to know what ‘rumors’ are.
: O-Of course I know what rumors are! Forgive me for caring more about my education than my social circle!
: So basically, I’m going to get two random girls just thrown into my class in the middle of the[school] year and I can’t do anything about it?
: In layman’s terms, yes.
: Are they aware of my...teaching methods?
: Your original ones or your current ones?
: Current ones.
: Absolutely not.
: They are in for a rude awakening if they are actually trying to learn.
: But on the bright side, if they’re normal girls who don’t care about that sort of thing, you’ll be a-okay.
: I like to believe that normal girls at least slightly care about their futures, so I don’t know if I’d count on that, Sensei.
Unfortunately for Makoto, I think I’d much prefer Ami’s type rather than hers in the class.
That’s not to say I don’t like Makoto. In fact, I think it’s pretty obvious that I like her a lot.
But more than one of her would just be way too much for me. I can barely keep up with her wealth of knowledge as-is.
: Well, I guess we’ll just have to see what happens then, right?
: Correct. I’ll handle most of the legwork for you, so all you really need to do is just have them introduce themselves once they transfer in.
: Really? Does the staff really trust you enough to handle that sort of thing instead of me?
: Of course. If anything, I’d even say they trust me more than you.
: Yeah...that makes sense.
Guess I can’t really blame them for that.
: Exactly. So, I suppose you can just keep doing what you always do and just deal with things as they come up.
: And in the meantime, I’ll see if there are any strings I can pull to get you one of the cuter girls.
: Wait a minute! Whose side are you even on?!
: The side that makes him happy.
: I figured you’d be on that side too, Ami. Given how much you claim to care about him and all.
: You...did NOT just say what I think you said, did you?...
: And with that, I shall take my leave. It’s been nice talking with you, Sensei.
Makoto suddenly vanishes from the office, leaving Ami in a fit of rage that she is unable to cope with.
: Sensei...
: I’ll be right back...
: I need to go commit a felony...
And then Ami disappears as well.
That’s interesting, though.
Two new students out of virtually nowhere.
I feel like the normal reaction for someone in my shoes would be something along the lines of, “Oh no. Extra work.”
But, being a man of culture and little-to-no-ethics...
I’m still just hoping they’re cute.
